Definition: properly, to boil up; hence, to be done in cooking; figuratively to ripen
BiblicalUsage: 1) to boil, cook, bake, roast, ripen, grow ripe; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to boil, cook; 1a2) to grow ripe, ripen; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to boil; 1b2) to cook; 1c) (Pual); 1c1) to be boiled; 1c2) to be sodden; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to ripen; 1d2) ripen, brought to ripeness
